properties.name: model-cards:integration_means
properties.value: Usable via Hugging Face transformers (AutoModelForImageTextToText; transformers>=4.55.0 required for the 20B version), and deployable with LMDeploy (pipeline, OpenAI-compatible api_server) or vLLM (recommended for InternVL3.5-20B-A4B since lmdeploy does not yet support GPT-OSS). Thinking mode is enabled via a system prompt (R1_SYSTEM_PROMPT) with do_sample=True and temperature=0.6.

properties.name: model-cards:distribution_channels
properties.value: Open model weights released publicly on Hugging Face (GitHub and HF formats) and ModelScope; all models and code publicly released. Deployable via LMDeploy and vLLM (vLLM recommended for the 20B-A4B model).

modelParameters.architectureFamily: "ViT–MLP–LLM" paradigm (vision encoder + MLP + language model); language model initialized from Qwen3 series and GPT-OSS, vision encoder from InternViT-300M and InternViT-6B; the 20B-A4B variant is a mixture-of-experts-style "A4B" model (21.2B-A4B)
modelParameters.modelArchitecture: Follows the "ViT–MLP–LLM" paradigm; language model initialized from the Qwen3 series and GPT-OSS, vision encoder from InternViT-300M and InternViT-6B; retains the Dynamic High Resolution strategy from InternVL1.5. This 20B-A4B model: 0.3B vision params, 20.9B language params, 21.2B total with 4B active (A4B).

useCases: Multimodal (vision-language) models supporting GUI interaction and embodied agency; deployable as online-served multimodal LLM services (e.g., via OpenAI-compatible API servers).
technicalLimitations: The card has no dedicated limitations section. It notes undesired repetition in Thinking mode, mitigated by do_sample=True and temperature=0.6. It also says lmdeploy has not yet supported GPT-OSS, so vLLM is recommended for InternVL3.5-20B-A4B.

properties.name: model-cards:design_rationale
properties.value: Cascade RL combines offline RL (MPO) as an efficient warm-up for stable convergence and high-quality rollouts, then online RL (GSPO) to refine the output distribution from the model's own rollouts, achieving significant gains at a fraction of the GPU time cost. GSPO was chosen because it is more effective for training both dense and MoE models. Square averaging re-weights the NTP loss to mitigate bias toward longer or shorter responses.

properties.name: model-cards:hyperparameters
properties.value: Only partial: during the SFT stage the context window is set to 32K tokens. The card does not state learning rate, batch size, optimiser or epochs.

properties.name: model-cards:required_hardware
properties.value: Models with up to 30B parameters can be deployed on a single A100 GPU; the 38B model requires two A100 GPUs and the 235B model requires eight A100 GPUs.

properties.name: model-cards:eval_methodology
properties.value: Evaluation conducted with VLMEvalkit. Thinking mode enabled by setting the system prompt to R1_SYSTEM_PROMPT; in Thinking mode, do_sample=True and temperature=0.6 recommended. Reported results are obtained without test-time scaling unless otherwise specified.

components.name: Training data of OpenGVLab/InternVL3_5-GPT-OSS-20B-A4B-Preview-HF (as described in the card)

data.name: training data
data.description:
data_modality: Text and multimodal (image-text) data; pre-training uses large-scale text and multimodal corpora
data_provenance: Only partly described: SFT data includes synthetic multimodal reasoning data (image descriptions from InternVL3-78B fed to DeepSeek-R1 to sample reasoning rollouts), plus reused InternVL3 instruction-following data; pre-training uses "large-scale text and multimodal corpora" with no further provenance given.
data_acquisition: SFT data comes from three sources: reused InternVL3 instruction-following data; multimodal "Thinking" reasoning data built by having InternVL3-78B describe images and DeepSeek-R1 sample reasoning rollouts, with rollouts with incorrect final answers filtered out; and capability-expansion datasets. Rights acquisition is not described.
data_scope: Pre-training uses large-scale text and multimodal corpora; SFT data includes instruction-following data from InternVL3, multimodal reasoning data in "Thinking" mode (covering expert domains such as mathematics and scientific disciplines), and capability-expansion datasets (e.g., GUI-based interaction, embodied interaction). Card metadata lists language as multilingual.
data_curation: Reasoning SFT data was built by having InternVL3-78B describe images and feeding the descriptions to DeepSeek-R1 to sample rollouts; rollouts with an incorrect final answer were filtered out. Random JPEG compression is included in pre-training as augmentation, and NTP loss is re-weighted by square averaging.
